title: GET /api/decks/:id/batches?state=done&unseen=1 (D1600, #3879)
description: The reply the deck v2 adapter's `unseenBatches` method passes through: the deck's finished runs nobody has opened from the return banner, newest first, at most five, each with the count of cards it left waiting. A count, never content (`routes/deck_batches.ts`).

finished_at.description: When the run ended; null only if it was not recorded.
